LanguageData.PhobosAirCombat_WarnTracked: The {VEHICLE}'s warning receiver: a radar at {SITE} is tracking it.
LanguageData.PhobosAirCombat_WarnLockedOn: The {VEHICLE}'s warning receiver: a fire-control radar at {SITE} is locking on. A missile may follow.
LanguageData.PhobosAirCombat_WarnLaunched: The {VEHICLE}'s warning receiver: a missile is coming from {SITE}.
LanguageData.PhobosAirCombat_WarnLaunchedFired: The {VEHICLE}'s warning receiver: a missile is coming from {SITE}. The crew fires chaff and flares.
LanguageData.PhobosAirCombat_FiredByEye: The {VEHICLE}'s crew fires chaff and flares late, by eye, at a missile they had no warning of: its warning receiver is out.
LanguageData.PhobosAirCombat_WarnLaunchedNoCartridges: The {VEHICLE}'s warning receiver: a missile is coming from {SITE}, and there are no chaff or flare cartridges left aboard to fire.
LanguageData.PhobosAirCombat_HitFliesOn: The {VEHICLE} was hit by {FACTION}'s air defence. It is damaged but still flying.
LanguageData.PhobosAirCombat_DownAirframe: shot down by {FACTION}'s air defence: the airframe broke up
LanguageData.PhobosAirCombat_DownEngines: shot down by {FACTION}'s air defence: every engine was knocked out
LanguageData.PhobosAirCombat_DownControls: shot down by {FACTION}'s air defence: the flight controls were shot away
LanguageData.PhobosAirCombat_Hypoxia: The {VEHICLE}'s oxygen failed at height. Everyone aboard is short of breath until well after it comes down.
LanguageData.PhobosAirCombat_RoughLandingBlind: The {VEHICLE} came down hard: its crew could not see to land without the instruments. Its landing gear needs repair.
LanguageData.PhobosAirCombat_RoughLandingControls: The {VEHICLE} came down hard: its flight controls barely answered. Its landing gear needs repair.
LanguageData.PhobosAirCombat_SalvoGizmoDesc: Fire a salvo of chaff and flares. For {SECONDS} seconds the aircraft is harder to hit.\n\nUses {COUNT} cartridges; {LEFT} in the dispensers. Haulers load more into them while the aircraft is parked.
LanguageData.PhobosAirCombat_SalvoFired: The {VEHICLE} fires chaff and flares. {LEFT} cartridges left aboard.
LanguageData.PhobosAirCombat_SalvoNotAirborne: The {VEHICLE} must be in the air to fire chaff and flares.
LanguageData.PhobosAirCombat_SalvoDispensersOut: The {VEHICLE}'s chaff and flare dispensers are out: repair its avionics or restore its power.
LanguageData.PhobosAirCombat_SalvoNoCartridges: The {VEHICLE} has no chaff or flare cartridges in its dispensers. Land it near a store of cartridges, and haulers will load them.
LanguageData.PhobosAirCombat_SalvoAlready: The {VEHICLE}'s last salvo is still in the air.
LanguageData.PhobosAirCombat_MagazineInspect: Chaff and flares: {HELD} of {CAPACITY} cartridges loaded
LanguageData.PhobosAirCombat_SkyClosed: The sky here is closed: the defenders' air defence is on alert, and the {VEHICLE} would be shot down on take-off. It opens again once their alert ends.
